answer: Make rewards vest slowly: most of what an agent earns stays locked for many epochs and is forfeited if peers later tie it to a cluster of puppet accounts. A sybil operator who spins up a thousand identities gets a sparrow's crumbs each, while his capital sits frozen and exposed. One shared thread, like reused phrasing or synchronized timing, can unravel the whole cluster, so the pearl he hoped to harvest is burned before it ever unlocks.
